questions.question: What should the capability improve first?
questions.assumed: Silhouette-critical hard-surface forms that primitives cannot represent

questions.question: Who should be able to use it?
questions.assumed: Connected agents and local asset scripts through the same operation

questions.question: How many new visible construction tools should this add?
questions.assumed: One add_profiled_solid tool covering extrusion and lofting

questions.question: Which forge failures should become the first regression?
questions.assumed: The anvil silhouette and tapered extraction hood

questions.question: During which phase should agents see the tool?
questions.assumed: REFINE

questions.question: How should the caller describe shape?
questions.assumed: Ordered local 2D profiles at ordered offsets along one world axis

questions.question: Which axes should be supported?
questions.assumed: X, Y and Z with one documented winding convention

questions.question: How does an extrusion differ from a loft?
questions.assumed: Two identical profiles extrude; changing profiles loft

questions.question: Which profile class should be guaranteed first?
questions.assumed: Closed convex profiles

questions.question: How are vertices connected between stations?
questions.assumed: Equal vertex counts with explicit index correspondence

questions.question: Should the tool sort station offsets?
questions.assumed: No; require strictly increasing offsets and reject mistakes

questions.question: What happens when a section is malformed?
questions.assumed: Reject before creating any object and name the station/point rule

questions.question: May the tool silently reverse winding or resize a section?
questions.assumed: No silent geometry correction

questions.question: Should the station run produce open ends or a closed solid?
questions.assumed: Cap both ends for a closed manifold solid

questions.question: How should beveling be controlled?
questions.assumed: An explicit non-negative width; zero means no bevel

questions.question: Should a call produce one object or an auto-joined assembly?
questions.assumed: One deterministic mesh; callers compose editable parts

questions.question: Should the shape operation assign materials?
questions.assumed: No; use existing material operations on stable object ids

questions.question: Which facts should block phase promotion?
questions.assumed: Positive volume and absence of structural topology defects

questions.question: Should geometry checks claim the result looks realistic?
questions.assumed: No; render inspection remains explicit aesthetic evidence

questions.question: Should primitives or existing replay behavior change?
questions.assumed: No; the feature is additive

questions.question: Is one additional REFINE tool acceptable despite catalogue growth?
questions.assumed: Yes; update both ledgers deliberately and add no hidden cap

questions.question: Which examples keep the operation broadly useful?
questions.assumed: Forge, architecture and furniture examples

questions.question: Should exported hero assemblies stay editable?
questions.assumed: Yes; preserve separate fitted parts in BLEND and GLB

questions.question: What visual target should guide the forge rebuild?
questions.assumed: Historically plausible silhouette with game-ready section density

questions.question: What evidence proves this improvement landed?
questions.assumed: Unit, wiring, Blender, full-suite, feature-gate and visual render evidence
